independence_note: Two publisher-level groups were inspected: the WSA planning map and the Elections Saskatchewan map series. The two election sheets count as one group. Shared underlying provincial data are possible; no claim of independently surveyed naming evidence is made.
availability_scope_note: The WSA and election maps supply complete target-area coverage. All three results are completed naming-scope holds, rather than access-pending records.
included_evidence_limit: Included records retain official bibliography, own factual observations and geometry facts. Source publications and inspection materials are excluded. Public offline validation checks included records and geometry; it does not reproduce visual map judgments.
